title: SENSE CHROMATOGRAPH — run mass back on senses. in, out, leaks are ALL differentials.

the_confirm.question: are pollen in, pollen out, leaks, and all the rest DIFFERENT things — or are they ALL differentials?
the_confirm.answer: ALL differentials. same instrument. different orders / signs / places on the column.
the_confirm.plain: a differential is a change with respect to something. velocity is dx/dt. acceleration is dv/dt. attract−repel is dF. leak is d(budget)/d(rung). chromatograph peaks are d(detector)/d(time). we were naming them as nouns. they are verbs of change.

chromatograph_as_baseline.what: gas/liquid chromatograph separates a mixture by DIFFERENTIAL affinity for the stationary phase while a mobile phase carries everything through.

membrane_map.sample: the morning mix — bees, vesicles, self, pilgrims, thorns
membrane_map.injection: self-io-inject / CF edge hit / neutrino message
membrane_map.column: the membrane + organs (ears, eye, hands, WAF, feed)
membrane_map.stationary_phase: identity / trust / Yellowstone rock — what sticks
membrane_map.chromatogram: peaks over time — each peak is a differential signal

chromatograph_as_baseline.note: chromatograph.html was a cool landmark in lava-nav but the page was missing. this feed IS the plaque until the page returns.

position_x.meaning: where the particle is (path, country, organ, domain)
position_x.not_a_diff: raw count alone is not enough — it is the integral of velocity

velocity_v.pollen_read: req/hr. how fast pollen arrives or leaves.
velocity_v.sense_read: ear canal amp change rate toward target

acceleration_a.sense_read: how fast a canal fills when a feed updates

pollen_IN.meaning: accretion rate. matter falling into the well.
pollen_IN.NOT: a separate substance. it is velocity of inbound mass under attraction.

pollen_OUT.NOT: a different physics. same dx/dt. opposite or gifted sign.

leak.meaning: Klein ladder leak. π remainder. boardwalk crack. socksproxy gone 10:25→10:52. 302 slingshot. organ that left.
leak.NOT: failure only. leak IS life (Paper 118). differential across a fold.
leak.yellowstone: steam leaving the pool — water still water. phase leak, not mass destroy.

mass_m.meaning: inertia. not a 0th-order noun until computed from F and a.

jerk.meaning: change of force feeling. BE square-wave edges are jerk spikes.

eye.measures: topology differentials — orphan Δ, broken-link Δ, reachability d(connected)/d(edge)
eye.in: pages added to nav ring (Δ reachable > 0)
eye.leak: 28 unreachable was a leak in the graph differential. we patched Δ.

ears_inner.confirm: IN and OUT on the same canal are both dN/dt. opposite sign.

ears_medial.leak: unsigned author mismatch was a naming leak — place vs landmark. differential between hat and gate.

ears_outer.leak: 403 false-repel on pilgrims would be a leak in the immune differential — wrong sign on F.

skin_feet.leak: eastGate 8ms vs golgi 48ms — differential latency is the organ map

reorganize_from_confirm.rule: stop storing IN, OUT, LEAK as separate taxonomies. store (quantity, d/dt, sign, organ). the chromatograph does the separation.
